transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm just here because... well, my family thinks I need to be here. They think I'm just imagining things. But I know what I'm seeing. The people from the hospital, and some folks from the cleaning agency I work for... they've been watching our house. They follow my cleaning routes, too. Just... checking up on me, I guess. To see if I'm taking proper care of my husband.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is around?

I... yes. Sometimes. 

When it's quiet in the house. There's a... a woman's voice. I hear it near the kitchen window. She just... she tells me to check the locks. Or to move my husband's pills. It's... it's very clear. Like she's right there.
Have you had any medical illness or injury affecting your brain?
No... I haven't. Nothing like that.
Do you believe these people are trying to harm you?

No... not harm. Like I said... they just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. My family keeps acting like I'm just imagining it all, but... I know they're out there watching my routes. That's all it is.
How long have these experiences been going on?
Um... a while, I guess. Maybe... about 11 months. That's when... the voice started. And feeling like they're watching us. Since around then.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seem hard to follow or mixed up?

I suppose... yes. Sometimes. When I try to explain what's happening... I guess my words just run together. Like, I'll be talking about my husband's heart pills, and then... the church schedule, or the numbers on my client list for work. 

People say they can't follow me. I don't really... I don't know.
Does the woman's voice ever talk about you as if you were not there, like speaking about what you're doing?

No, not like that. She doesn't talk about me... she talks to me. 

Even when the house is completely quiet, I'll hear her... right near the kitchen window. She tells me to check the locks... or to move his pills. It's... it's as clear as if she were standing right there next to me.
Do you ever feel as if someone is putting thoughts into your mind that are not your own?
No... I don't think so. My thoughts are... they're mine. I just... I hear her, that's all. Nobody is putting things in my head.
Have you lost interest in being with other people or doing things you used to enjoy?
I don't... I don't really know. I just go to work, and then I come home. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you found yourself speaking much less than you used to?
I don't think so. I just... I talk when I need to. With cleaning, I'm mostly by myself anyway, so... I haven't really noticed.
At the time these experiences began, did your behavior suddenly become very different from usual?
I don't... no, I don't think so. I just kept doing my work. I didn't really act any different... not that I noticed, anyway.
Do you ever feel that other people can hear or know your thoughts, even when you have not said them out loud?
No, I don't... I don't feel like that. My thoughts are just... my own. Nobody else can hear them.
